🐔🛸 WHY CAN’T YOU JUST WALK INTO OUR CHICKEN BARNS?

🚨 FARM BIOSECURITY ISN’T ABOUT HIDING ANYTHING — IT’S ABOUT PROTECTING OUR ANIMALS! 🚨

At Roswell Family Farm, we believe in transparency. We want our customers to know where their food comes from, how their chickens are raised, and the care that goes into producing quality farm-raised meat.

But there’s something important everyone should understand:

🇺🇸 THE USDA RECOMMENDS RESTRICTING ACCESS TO POULTRY HOUSING AREAS!

The USDA’s Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) provides biosecurity guidance encouraging poultry producers to limit visitors and control access to their birds.

New York State’s Department of Agriculture and Markets also advises that visitors should NOT enter poultry housing areas without express permission from farm management.

🐥 WHY ARE THESE PRECAUTIONS SO IMPORTANT?

🦠 Avian Influenza (Bird Flu): Dangerous poultry diseases can be introduced through contaminated shoes, clothing, equipment, and vehicles.

🐔 Protecting Our Flock: Even someone who has never been around a sick bird can unknowingly carry harmful pathogens onto a farm.

🚜 Preventing Cross-Contamination: Visiting multiple farms, keeping backyard chickens, or coming into contact with wild birds can increase biosecurity risks.

❤️ Animal Welfare: Our chickens depend on us to provide a healthy, safe environment. One preventable disease outbreak could devastate an entire flock.

🚫 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN AT ROSWELL FAMILY FARM?

Our chicken barns, brooder facilities, and designated poultry production areas are RESTRICTED ACCESS.

That means:

✅ No unauthorized entry into poultry housing.

✅ No unannounced visits to our poultry facilities.

✅ Visitors must receive permission before entering restricted areas.

✅ Any approved visitors must follow our farm’s biosecurity procedures.

THIS ISN’T ABOUT KEEPING SECRETS. IT’S ABOUT KEEPING OUR CHICKENS SAFE.

We are proud of how our animals are raised, and we’re happy to share photos, videos, and behind-the-scenes updates showing the work that goes into raising our poultry.

But protecting our animals will ALWAYS come before allowing unnecessary foot traffic through our facilities.

📚 DON’T JUST TAKE OUR WORD FOR IT — READ THE OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT GUIDANCE!

🇺🇸 USDA APHIS — Defend the Flock:
https://www.aphis.usda.gov/livestock-poultry-disease/avian/defend-the-flock/biosecurity-basics/control-what-comes

🏛️ NYS Department of Agriculture & Markets — Biosecurity Guidelines for Poultry Farm Visitors:
https://agriculture.ny.gov/animals/biosecurity-guidelines-poultry-farm-visitors

💚 We believe customers deserve transparency, animals deserve protection, and responsible farmers must provide both.

🛸🐔 ROSWELL FAMILY FARM
